title: Dental Handpiece Supplies
agency_path: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE.NAVAJO AREA INDIAN HEALTH SVC
detail_text: The Synopsis The Indian Health Service, Navajo Area, Crownpoint Healthcare Facility, located at Crownpoint, New Mexico 87313 has an upcoming requirement for Dental Handpiece Supplies. ARO 30 days. The North American Industry Classification System or NAICS code is 339114: Dental Equipment and Supplies Manufacturing with a small business size standard of 750 Employees. The Request for Quotations No. 75H71026Q00099 in accordance with 12.201-1 will be issued on or by March 21, 2026. Evaluation factors may include technical acceptability to meet the government needs, price, and delivery. Quotes will be due on or by March 30, 2026. The acquisition is an ISBEE set aside. In accordance with 52.204-7 the offeror shall have an active Federal Government contracts registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) when submitting an offer or quotation in response to this solicitation and at the time of award. For additional information, contact Brenda Joe, Contract Specialist at Brenda.joe@ihs.gov. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION.
